title: Calculate Perimeter with Missing Side Lengths

instruction.text: Which sum should you use to work out the perimeter of the shape below? Select the correct answer.

hint.text: Perimeter is the total distance around a shape. The correct sum should include all the lengths of the shape’s sides, including the missing side. You can find the missing side by working out what the shape is, then working out if any of the shape’s sides are equal.

instruction.text: What is the perimeter of the shape? Write the correct answer.

atoms.finishSound: The perimeter of the shape is 12.
